label: Systematized Freudian dream-work and parapraxes through Lacanian linguistic clinical technique
description: Fink demonstrated how Freud's clinical discoveries of condensation, displacement, and jokes operate as pure signifier mechanics.
historicalContext: Fink elucidated Freud's case histories (Dora, Little Hans, Rat Man) in 'Clinical Introduction' (1997).
dialecticalTension: Applying classical Freudian texts to contemporary Lacanian technique with variable-length sessions.
